Allard Lissara|<ref name="P14.1">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref>}}
'''Allard Lissara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Lissara served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and was stationed at the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:BIttER" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Lt. Lissara was contacted by [[Jaek Vercet]], Imperial Representative to the Naboo city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] about a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] informant who was willing to defect to the Empire. The individual was willing to give information if the Empire offer him immunity.<ref name="P14.1" /> Vercet therefore recruited an Imperial operative to escort the Rebel informant to Allard Lissara at the Emperor's Retreat. However, the informant was attacked and injured. Unable to move, he requested the Imperial operative to deliver a codephrase to Lissara: "Wookiees walk at night in the trees of Naboo." The operative delivered successfully the correct codephrase and was commended by Allard Lissara.<ref name="SWG:BIttER" />

==Behind the scenes==
Allard Lissara was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BIttER" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lt. Allard Lissara was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]], on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="P14.1" />
